column3: ASCEND, A Study of Cardiovascular Events iN Diabetes, is the University of Oxford's: the registry gives its lead sponsor as University of Oxford (class OTHER) and lists nine collaborators, Bayer one of three in industry beside the British Heart Foundation, the Medical Research Council, Abbott and Mylan. Its interventions are aspirin and omega-3 ethyl esters against matching placebos, and it matched Bayer only because Bayer owns a product of aspirin (Measurin). Its primary completion was 2018-03-12, reported in full (PMIDs 31986094, 35393614); the record stays active for long-term follow-up. An academic trial of a generic Bayer supplied, finished eight years ago, is not a Bayer gate (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00135226, read 2026-11-16).
